title: Discord desktop data
whyItMatters: Discord stores the signed-in account, server list, message cache and voice settings. Anyone with the folder can see which servers and conversations the person took part in.
source: Arch Wiki, Discord: configuration and cache are kept in ~/.config/discord and ~/.cache/discord: https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Discord
notes: The directory is lowercase discord. Canary and PTB builds use discordcanary and discordptb, which this rule does not match. The Flatpak uses ~/.var/app/com.discordapp.Discord/config/discord.

cleanup.signOut: In Discord, open the user settings with the cog next to your name and press Log Out, so the session on this computer ends.
steps: Quit Discord from its tray icon.
Uninstall Discord from the App Center if you are removing the app itself.
Move the folder named in the plan to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes the signed-in session, the message cache, drafts and downloaded files. Messages on the Discord servers are untouched.
cleanup.source: Discord Support, How do I log out?: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/209572128-How-do-I-log-out
